theorems.name: Submission.bv_tendstoLocallyInL1On_of_exhaustion_limits
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (Q : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (w G : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsCompact (Q j)) → Monotone Q → (∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ j, K ⊆ Q j) → (∀ j k, AEStronglyMeasurable (w k) (volume.restrict (Q j))) → (∀ j, IntegrableOn (G j) (Q j) volume) → (∀ j, Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫⁻ x in Q j, ‖w k x - G j x‖ₑ) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∃ v : Rn n → ℝ, LocallyIntegrableOn v U volume ∧ Chapter02.TendstoLocallyInL1On w v U atTop
